title: Predictive Role-Bundles & Micro-Triage Capacity Protocol for Mid-Cycle Scope Shocks
creator: Ava Chen
description: Deliver a lightweight, playbook-driven protocol that combines predictive staffing bundles with a micro-triage decision engine to reduce unplanned scope cuts and reactionary role switches mid-cycle. The protocol defines bundled role groups (e.g., API+Infra, UX+PM triage pairings), a short decision matrix for scope de-scoping, and automated signals that surface to PMs/EMs. This ticket covers the rubric, runbook pages, sprint simulation, a small console dashboard (alerts-only view) and a pilot with two cross-functional squads. Goal: reduce high-friction mid-cycle scope cuts and keep SLAs for Dedicated and Hosted product initiatives intact.

outcome_criteria: Pilot reduction in unplanned scope cuts by >= 10% compared to previous two cycles
No regression in SLA metrics for customer-facing endpoints during pilot
Pilot squads report <2 instances of emergency role reassignments per sprint
playbook_steps: Step 0: Pre-cycle intake - tag candidate stories that are 'slice-ready' and identify vertical test owners
Step 1: Create two role-bundles per squad (Core API bundle; Release & Observability bundle). Each bundle is 0.6 FTE across the sprint window
Step 2: Configure three automated triggers in Console alerts (latency, throughput delta, incident count)
Step 3: When a trigger fires, run the 6-question micro-triage matrix (impact, customer reach, rework cost, testability, rollback cost, alternative routes)
Step 4: Apply one of three actions: (A) temporary scope freeze + borrow from soft-buffer, (B) scoped rollback of lowest-risk slices, (C) escalate to cycle response council if >1 trigger persists
Step 5: Rebalance next sprint tranche depending on actual velocity and leftover technical debt
mitigation_triggers: Latency SLO breach: p95 > target for two consecutive hours
Velocity delta: rolling week throughput down >18% vs baseline
Incident window: more than 2 Sev2+ incidents in 48 hours affecting customer routes
pilot_scope: Artifacts: trimmed-slice catalog, cut-proposals doc, pilot dashboard
